articles.title: INS Nipun Commissioned: Indian Navy Gets New Underwater Power | What Makes This New Vessel Special?
articles.description: The Indian Navy has commissioned INS Nipun, its second Diving Support Vessel, at the Naval Dockyard in Mumbai, marking a significant addition to the Navy’s specialised underwater capabilities.Built by Hindustan Shipyard Limited (HSL), INS Nipun is designed to support a range of complex underwater operations, including saturation diving, air diving and mixed-gas/heliox diving.The vessel can also deploy Remotely Operated Vehicles (ROVs) and support operations involving a Deep Submergence Rescue Vehicle (DSRV), strengthening India’s ability to conduct deep-sea operations, underwater search and rescue and specialised diving missions.The commissioning of INS Nipun further strengthens the Indian Navy’s underwater support infrastructure and reflects India’s growing shipbuilding capabilities under the Atmanirbhar Bharat initiative.Watch the key features and capabilities of INS Nipun. -News18 is your trusted source for breaking news, updates, and in-depth analysis from around the world.
